items.title: Giving online through ChurchCRM
items.summary: Let members give online by card or bank transfer and have the gift recorded in ChurchCRM automatically. Vote if online giving should be the next feature built; the technical design is RFC 0005.

items.title: Send a text from ChurchCRM to people and groups
items.summary: Send a text message to a person, a group, or your whole congregation right from ChurchCRM. Vote if texting should be the next feature built; the design is RFC 0009.

items.title: Keep some family or note records private
items.summary: Some notes and family records are sensitive. Tell us what your church needs to keep private and who should be able to see it; your answers shape the access-control work in RFC 0002.

items.title: Module-based access control (RFC 0002)
items.summary: Decide who can see and change what, module by module, instead of a few broad roles. This is the technical review thread for RFC 0002; comments here go straight into the design.
